objective: Measure whether corpus-derived complete bilingual phrase spans and context-conditioned complete lexical heads increase useful local source-first immersion beyond word-only matching without serially authoring a small vocabulary batch.

directionality.record_schema: Explicit source_language,target_language,source/target complete token+character spans, direct pair origin, both forward/reverse word alignments. No pivot-created bilingual relation.
directionality.japanese: Deferred until an existing native tokenizer capture is bound to the selected direct Japanese records. Do not use the Latin regex to treat unsegmented Japanese as one token.
directionality.requirement_remaining: At least ten major languages and their pairs including Swahili remains unmet by this bounded pilot.

pgv.license: CC-BY-4.0: PGV alignment distribution; Global Voices attribution license retained
pgv.citation: Prokopis Prokopidis, Vassilis Papavassiliou and Stelios Piperidis. 2016. Parallel Global Voices: a collection of multilingual corpora with citizen media stories. LREC 2016.
pgv.domain: Global Voices published articles, automatically aligned translation units; not ordinary friend chat.
pgv.selection: Only both endpoints partition=development. Preserve original component IDs and archive+unit+score. Reserved and excluded-existing-source never enter training. No inference of document independence because TMX lacks article IDs.
pgv.row_hashing: Every selected original text/ID/provenance record receives SHA256; subset files receive fresh complete hashes. No claim the whole2GB file was freshly hashed or restored.

explicit_dictionary_spans.qualification: 112304 explicit usage-example source/target focus spans in18directions, not complete phrase alignment or semantic gold. EN–ES3733; noSwahili. Optional76MB exact restore for corroboration, never replace PGV provenance/license.
explicit_dictionary_spans.source_scope: Exact native headword/sense/example IDs and marked source/target spans only; reading must remain attached to same target example identity.

dictionary_assets.use: Corroborate complete lexical units and preserve all target alternatives; native dictionary membership alone is not sense correctness.

selection_recipe: Scan only indexed link_evidence rows for the exact pinned archive URL; choose SHA256(seed|archive|unit) minimum metadata candidates without reading target text for ranking.
Fetch selected sentence endpoints through bounded primary-key batches, verify exact language pair and both development partitions, retain original text/component/source archive unit.

Normalize only for duplicate detection: existing fingerprint(NFC, whitespace, case) with explicit source/target language. Deduplicate exact direct pair/component evidence; repeated units remain provenance, not independent support.
Drop empty/delimiter-invalid or out-of-bound tokenizations;2–60tokens per side. Retain reason counts and rejected identity hashes.

Use frozen hash order to fill accepted caps; do not replace inputs based on alignment output or translation quality. Preserve explicit incomplete results if source I/O/resource deadline prevents completion.
training_selection.evaluation_exclusions: Before pair extraction freeze hashes of all explicit source/target texts from retained coverage_ceiling experiment protocols and NLP authored cases. Exclude exact evaluated text as a training sentence, report overlap counts. Phrase overlap is allowed: common phrase reuse is the hypothesis, and prior reused TRAIN is diagnostic, not fresh acceptance.
training_selection.not_reproduction: Historical100000EN–ES/20955EN–SW fast_align artifacts not located via bounded metadata checks; this is a new hash-frozen run from retained PGV, not a claimed reproduction.

tokenization.preserve: Original complete token text, codepoint start/end and derived UTF16 start/end; training casefold view stored separately. No stemming, target shortening or implicit transliteration.
tokenization.runtime: Retain later native complete-token and literal guards; Latin training tokens are not silently substituted for platform native geometry.

source_frequency_selection.candidate_windows: All complete1–8word native windows; rank distinct source-message frequency, occurrence frequency, then normalized lexical key. Frequency is source-only, independent of target scores.
source_frequency_selection.normalization: NFC casefold for lookup/ranking only; raw spelling/ranges and case/protected-text risks remain in trace. No change to frozen NLP-r01 case-sensitive policy.
source_frequency_selection.limits: Retained BST TRAIN role-play frequency is not worldwide chat frequency. No unseen holdout consumed for tooling.

alignment.build: Reuse pinned source if available; otherwise acquire exact small pinned source archive and retain LICENSE/hash. No new neural model, GPU or app dependency.
alignment.training: Forward and reverse IBM2 fast_align,5iterations, diagonal preference/tension optimization as pinned historical training script; exact commands/parameters recorded before execution.
alignment.control: Historical one-to-one mutual links recreated from this new run, labelled word-only proposals, never accepted runtime rows.
alignment.retain: All original directional links and exact symmetrization results. No probability cutoff is called semantic confidence.

phrase_extraction.method: Enumerate selected source spans; derive the minimal connected target interval. Require no alignment from that target interval to source words outside the source span. Enumerate permitted unaligned left/right target boundary expansions within caps. Retain every variant, including minimal/truncated candidates, with original text/offsets/link evidence.
phrase_extraction.boundary_policy: Do not cross sentence-ending punctuation in source or target. Preserve exact native-checkable character ranges. Report phrases withheld by scope limits.
phrase_extraction.important_limit: Alignment consistency and unaligned boundary expansion do not establish completeness or correct sense. Do not choose the shortest target, silently collapse variants, or call frequency semantic evidence.
phrase_extraction.dictionary_comparison: Mark full target variants matching complete sense-linked lexical units and explicit dictionary usage spans; preserve incompatible/ambiguous/unsupported variants instead of deleting them.
output_kinds: context-conditioned complete lexical head only when its complete source+target scope has explicit independent dictionary/example evidence
recognition-only atomic scope when smaller substitutions would be unsupported
phrase_extraction.no_grammar_generation: No target string interpolation, dependency parser, embeddings or arbitrary morphology generation.

controls: complete attested head within matched phrase context
union with frozen editorial-runtime-r03 source-only control, clearly unpromoted
comparison.raw_candidate_selection: Frequency-ranked source inventory first. For a diagnostic top-corpus target arm, choose distinct-component joint count descending, then bidirectional lexical score descending, then stable target ID solely to make ties reproducible. Preserve all alternatives/ties. A separate dictionary-complete-unit arm is reported; neither is automatically promoted.
metrics: correct selected source-word depth and clean-message reach after review
whole-reference availability separate from automatic mixed-budget output
distinct content concepts and learned-content depletion
introduced meaning/scope errors vs bilingual source/alignment errors
all target variants and complete-unit recovery including laptop/email diagnostics
comparison.semantic_sample: Freeze deterministic96 scoped proposals by source frequency quartile, pair, source length1vs2–3vs4–8, target expansion vs minimal/head class, and ambiguity state. Retain original source+target sentence and alternate variants. Root independently reviews before author labels are joined. Separately retain complete uncensored ranked outputs and known historical laptop/email diagnostics.
comparison.acceptance: No population90% claim or publication from raw reach/test counts. A useful reviewed increment can progress to native QA; distribution/license and runtime activation remain separate.

resources.host: system76-pc bounded local research under parent authorization
resources.failure_policy: Stop with partial receipts on resource/time violation; no new host, VM, GPU, model service, tmpfs build or full2GB source restore.

publication: Retain per-row license/source attribution so an accepted catalog can exclude restricted sources without repeating alignment training. Experimental extraction is not app-pack publication.
